Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIPS Senior Research Officer (SRO) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the IIPS recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the International Institute for Population Sciences (IIPS) recruitment is Senior Research Officer (SRO).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the SRO post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Senior Research Officer (SRO) position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application for this recruitment is Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for the SRO post?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a Ph.D. degree in Statistics/Biostatistics/Mathematics/Demography/Population Studies, along with a degree/diploma/certificate in Population Studies/Demography and Statistics/Biostatistics/Mathematics.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Research Officer position?
faq.answer: The salary offered ranges from Rs. 37,000/- to Rs. 70,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled for 04 September 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview venue located?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview venue is located at International Institute for Population Sciences (IIPS), Mumbai, Maharashtra, 400088.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the SRO post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Senior Research Officer (SRO) post will be through a Walk-In Interview.
